title: Thai-Style Skillet Chicken
description: A spicy Thai-inspired dish made by sautéing chicken, fennel, and Canadian ingredients in a skillet.
instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned on both sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Add the sliced fennel to the skillet and cook until it starts to soften, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the maple syrup, soy sauce, fish sauce, and red pepper flakes to the skillet and stir to combine.
Return the chicken to the skillet and stir to coat with the sauce.
Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer, covered, until the chicken is cooked through, about 10-12 minutes.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve hot.
Serve with steamed rice or noodles, if desired.
